description.en:
Stuck in the mud? Turn on Oh No I Am Stuck and your throttle drives every wheel of the combination: the tractor's differentials lock and every attached trailer or implement wheel gets drive torque too.
Controls (while sitting in the vehicle, all rebindable - hold the left + right mouse button to see the key hints): - Left Alt + W: drive assist on / off - Left Alt + Q: change strength (low / medium / high)
The trailer wheels only get torque while you give throttle, and the assist fades out above 12 km/h, so it only helps you get going and doesn't push you at speed.
